assets.purpose: Full-body front, left profile, back, three-quarter reference
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D character turnaround for a Blender anime JRPG character. Input image is the sole identity and costume design reference: Mio, an adult woman of 22. Create one high-resolution landscape sheet containing FOUR equally sized FULL BODY views in a single horizontal row: strict FRONT, LEFT PROFILE facing left, BACK, and FRONT THREE-QUARTER facing left. All views depict exactly the SAME design, same relaxed neutral A-pose with arms 15 degrees from body, hands relaxed, feet flat, SAME height and head size, aligned ground and eye levels, orthographic/no perspective distortion for first three. Clean white background, simple small labels beneath each view. Professional polished Japanese anime model-sheet illustration with fine controlled linework, flat local colors and restrained soft cel shading, not a 3D render. Preserve the reference's composed mature face, narrow expressive almond amber eyes, defined upper lash line, modest small nose, nuanced compact jaw and chin, natural sloped shoulders, navy black swept asymmetric fringe and high gathered ponytail with varied overlapping locks. Preserve dark desaturated petrol teal fitted travel coat with turned layered gold-trim lapels and raised open collar, ivory blouse with real sewn folds, crimson loosely gathered scarf, brown overlapping diagonal belts, dark fitted trousers, knee-high brown riding boots. Right hand holds no sword for clear silhouette; show original single-edged sword separately as small accessory only if room. Preserve asymmetry: satchel and ornate jade terminal on HER LEFT side (viewer RIGHT in front view), shoulder strap follows that side and back, no mirroring errors. Give whole boots and hands sufficient margin. Preserve credible slender adult JRPG proportions and original costume fullness; no inflated tubular sleeves, no round doll eyes, no flat mannequin torso, no chibi head, no enormous breasts, no face beautification that changes identity. Scarf ends hang naturally rather than windblown so all views describe the same shape. Back coat has waist seam, center vent, draped tails and strap continuation. This is a precise construction reference: make the front, side and back silhouettes and all seam/accessory positions correspond. Do not copy the scenery or pose from the input.

assets.purpose: Head front, left profile, three-quarter, back reference; iris source
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a high resolution landscape production anime HEAD TURNAROUND sheet for Mio. References: first image is the original design identity, second is the corresponding full body turnaround; match the SAME adult woman and costume. Show four large head-and-shoulder drawings at identical scale: strict FRONT, strict LEFT PROFILE facing left, FRONT THREE-QUARTER facing left, and BACK. White background, fine Japanese anime linework and controlled soft cel shading, crisp visible facial landmarks. Calm focused mature amber almond eyes with shaped upper eyelids and lashes, iris partly occluded by upper lid (never round wide doll eyes); natural subtle brows; modest nose; compact lower face and softened pointed chin; graceful neck into natural sloping shoulders. Preserve original dark navy swept asymmetric layered fringe, ponytail tied high at back with brown-gold clasp, wispy varied overlapping locks. In profile show believable forehead-nose-lips-chin contour, jaw angle below ear and proper chin-to-neck transition, not a straight wedge. Preserve crimson gathered scarf and raised layered teal/gold travel coat collar. Keep head size, brow/eye/nose/mouth/chin/ear levels aligned between views, no changed identity, no expressions or extra characters. No dramatic lighting, no scenic background, no painterly shadows concealing anatomy, no 3D render. Only small view labels. This will be used to trace the actual 3D face; correspondence and likeness matter more than ornament.

assets.purpose: Costume material atlas matching turnaround colors
assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Make a 2x2 seamless-texture material atlas. First reference is the existing atlas: preserve the exact four equal quadrant layout and their order. Second reference is Mio's definitive turnaround: match its restrained dark colors and anime surface finish. TOP LEFT: dark desaturated petrol teal cloth like her coat (#294247 approximate). TOP RIGHT: warm ivory blouse cotton. BOTTOM LEFT: muted deep burgundy/crimson scarf cloth. BOTTOM RIGHT: dark worn brown leather matching her boots and satchel. Completely flat evenly lit swatches filling each quarter edge to edge, no borders, no labels, no shadows or gradients, no objects. Extremely subtle fine grain only, no visible woven diagonal lines, no fuzzy wool or carpet texture, no pronounced speckle. The four quarters should read almost flat at game distance. Keep the reference atlas orientation exactly.

notes: Images are construction references with small cross-view discrepancies, not exact orthographic measurements.
Existing runtime rig and animation clips are retained; surfaces are fitted and modeled against the new references.
Direct whole-face projection was rejected after inspection because hair from the drawing appeared on the cheeks.
